大语言模型与软件工程.title: Harnessing Code Agents for Automatic Software Verification
大语言模型与软件工程.title_zh: 利用代码代理实现自动软件验证
大语言模型与软件工程.summary: Formal verification offers the strongest guarantee of software correctness, but it does not scale: the proofs demanded by interactive theorem provers such as Coq require enormous expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) promise to generate these proofs automatically, yet existing approaches wire
大语言模型与软件工程.summary_zh: 形式化验证提供了软件正确性的最强保证，但其可扩展性差：交互式定理证明器（如Coq）所需的证明需要大量专家投入。大语言模型有望自动生成这些证明，但现有方法将LLM直接嵌入证明循环中，导致高昂的推理成本且难以处理长证明。本文提出一种代码代理框架，将LLM作为高层的证明策略生成器，而将低层的证明搜索任务委托给专门的自动化工具。该框架通过迭代细化策略，在多个基准测试上显著提升了证明成功率，同时降低了LLM的调用次数。主要贡献包括：提出了代理与自动化工具协作的范式，设计了策略生成与执行分离的架构，并在标准数据集上验证了有效性。

计算机视觉与生成模型.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
计算机视觉与生成模型.title_zh: ELSA3D：用于统一3D理解与生成的弹性语义锚定

Existing methods concatenate text and 3D tokens into a flat sequence and rely on self-attention, collapsing coarse structural
计算机视觉与生成模型.summary_zh: 统一的3D基础模型旨在单个骨干网络中同时实现3D资产生成和语言推理，但文本-3D交互仍然隐式且粗糙。现有方法将文本和3D令牌拼接成平坦序列，依赖自注意力机制，导致粗粒度的结构信息丢失。本文提出弹性语义锚定（ELSA3D）框架，通过引入可学习的语义锚点作为文本与3D空间之间的显式桥梁，实现细粒度的跨模态对齐。锚点弹性地调整其位置和语义，以适应不同的3D结构和文本描述。在多个3D理解和生成任务上，ELSA3D显著优于现有方法，尤其擅长处理复杂语义关系和精细几何细节。主要贡献包括：提出了弹性锚定机制，实现了文本与3D的显式交互；设计了统一的训练范式，兼顾理解与生成；在多个基准上达到了最先进性能。

大语言模型与认知架构.title: From Application-Layer Simulation to Native Meta-Architecture: Structural Tension as an Endogenous Driver for Heterogeneous AI Evolution
大语言模型与认知架构.title_zh: 从应用层模拟到原生元架构：结构性张力作为异构AI进化的内源驱动力
大语言模型与认知架构.summary: Current large language models (LLMs) are fundamentally stateless: their behavior is fully determined by input at inference time, and any higher-order cognitive architecture must be simulated at the application layer through prompt engineering and context management. This paper proposes a theoretical
大语言模型与认知架构.summary_zh: 当前的大语言模型本质上是无状态的：其行为完全由推理时的输入决定，任何高阶认知架构都必须在应用层通过提示工程和上下文管理来模拟。本文提出一个理论框架，将结构性张力（即不同AI组件之间的目标冲突）作为驱动异构AI系统进化的内生机制。核心思想是设计一种原生元架构，其中多个专门化的AI模块通过竞争与合作关系动态交互，从而在系统层面涌现出更复杂的认知能力，而无需人工设计提示。论文从理论角度论证了该框架的可行性，并提出了实现路线图。主要贡献包括：提出了结构性张力的概念作为AI进化的驱动力；设计了原生元架构的蓝图；为构建更自主、更灵活的AI系统提供了理论基础。

临床决策支持系统.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
临床决策支持系统.title_zh: 大型癌症助手（LCA）：用于肿瘤学可扩展临床决策支持的模型无关编排框架
临床决策支持系统.summary: - Objective: Multimodal deep learning models in oncology are currently limited by monolithic designs that rigidly couple data ingestion, clinical routing, and artificial intelligence (AI) inference. To address this inflexibility, we propose the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a model-agnostic, post-ho
临床决策支持系统.summary_zh: 肿瘤学中的多模态深度学习模型目前受限于单体设计，将数据摄入、临床路由和AI推理刚性耦合。为解决这一问题，本文提出大型癌症助手（LCA），一个模型无关、后置的编排框架，可灵活组合多个专用AI模型（如影像分析、基因组学、病理学模型）以支持临床决策。LCA通过统一的接口调度模型，并利用知识图谱增强推理，实现可解释的推荐。在多个肿瘤学数据集上，LCA在诊断准确性和治疗建议合理性上优于单一模型和简单集成方法。主要贡献包括：提出了模型无关的编排架构；设计了基于知识图谱的推理增强机制；在实际临床场景中验证了可扩展性和有效性。

量子机器学习.title: Provable learning separation for predicting time-evolution of quantum many-body systems
量子机器学习.title_zh: 预测量子多体系统时间演化的可证明学习分离
量子机器学习.summary: Given that quantum computers are naturally suited to simulate the behavior of quantum many-body systems, an immediate question arises: can one formulate physically motivated quantum machine learning (QML) tasks that exhibit learning separations? We address this problem by studying the learnability o
量子机器学习.summary_zh: 鉴于量子计算机天然适合模拟量子多体系统的行为，一个直接的问题是：能否构造出具有物理动机的量子机器学习任务，并展示学习分离（即量子模型优于经典模型）？本文通过研究量子多体系统时间演化的可学习性来回答这一问题。我们证明，在特定假设下，量子模型能够高效学习并预测某些量子系统的动力学，而经典模型则面临指数级样本复杂度的障碍。这一分离来源于量子纠缠结构所提供的信息优势。主要贡献包括：严格证明了量子学习优势的存在；给出了具体的量子任务实例；为量子机器学习提供了理论基础。

生成模型.title: TILDE: TILt-based Distributional Erasure for Concept Unlearning
生成模型.title_zh: TILDE：基于倾斜分布擦除的概念遗忘方法
生成模型.summary: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is critical for safe and practical deployment: with rising privacy concerns, copyright disputes, trademark constraints, and safety regulations, deployed systems must be able to suppress unwanted concepts after training. Existing methods often remove concepts by fine-tuning on negative prompts or using classifier guidance, but they struggle with complete removal while preserving model utility. We propose TILDE, a novel method that leverages the tilt of the distribution to erase target concepts. By analyzing the latent space geometry, we identify a direction that maximally separates the target concept from others. We then apply a tilt-based erasure that shifts the distribution along this direction, effectively removing the concept while maintaining generation quality. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that TILDE achieves superior concept removal with minimal impact on unrelated concepts.
生成模型.summary_zh: 文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘对于安全部署至关重要，现有方法难以在完全移除目标概念的同时保持模型效用。本文提出TILDE方法，通过分析潜空间几何结构，找到最大化分离目标概念的方向，并沿该方向倾斜分布以实现概念擦除。实验表明，该方法在标准基准上实现了优越的概念移除效果，且对无关概念影响极小。

生成模型.title: Self-Supervised Implicit CEST Reconstruction via Physics-Informed Lorentz Encoding
生成模型.title_zh: 通过物理信息洛伦兹编码的自监督隐式CEST重建
生成模型.summary: Multi-Pool Chemical Exchange Saturation Transfer (CEST) MRI provides valuable metabolic information but is clinically limited by long acquisition times. Although sparse sampling reduces scanning time, reconstructing high-resolution Z-spectra from limited data remains an ill-posed inverse problem. Co
生成模型.summary_zh: 多池化学交换饱和转移磁共振成像提供宝贵的代谢信息，但采集时间长限制了临床应用。稀疏采样虽能缩短扫描时间，但从有限数据重建高分辨率Z谱仍是一个不适定逆问题。本文提出一种自监督隐式神经表示方法，结合物理信息洛伦兹编码，利用MRI物理模型作为先验，无需全采样标签即可实现高质量重建。该方法在保持代谢信息准确性的同时，显著减少了采集时间，为CEST MRI的临床推广提供了新途径。

生成模型.title: Designing Maintainable Hybrid Generative Systems: A Quantum-Inspired Approach to Automated Music Harmony Generation
生成模型.title_zh: 设计可维护的混合生成系统：一种量子启发式的自动音乐和声生成方法
生成模型.summary: This paper presents the design and evaluation of a maintainable hybrid generative architecture for automated music harmony generation from melody. The proposed system combines quantum-inspired candidate exploration over overlapping melodic contexts with explicit rule-based optimization to balance generative creativity and structural coherence, while ensuring maintainability through modular design. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach outperforms purely neural and purely rule-based baselines in terms of harmonic quality, diversity, and system maintainability.
生成模型.summary_zh: 本文提出并评估了一种可维护的混合生成架构，用于从旋律自动生成和声。该系统将量子启发的候选探索（在重叠的旋律上下文中）与显式的基于规则的优化相结合，以平衡生成创造性与结构连贯性，并通过模块化设计确保可维护性。实验结果表明，在和声质量、多样性和系统可维护性方面，该方法优于纯神经网络和纯基于规则的基线方法。

生成模型.title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
生成模型.title_zh: 世界模型的定义与路线图
生成模型.summary: World models -- internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment -- have become one of the most actively debated concepts in AI. From model-based reinforcement learning and video generation to embodied robotics and ultimately, physical AI, researchers across AI subfields a
生成模型.summary_zh: 世界模型——学习环境结构和动态的内部模拟器——已成为AI领域最活跃的概念之一。从基于模型的强化学习、视频生成到具身机器人，乃至最终的物理AI，各子领域的研究人员都在探索其潜力。然而，由于缺乏统一定义和系统路线图，相关研究进展碎片化。本文提出世界模型的正式定义，将其视为一种能够学习环境状态转移和因果结构的生成模型，并构建了从基础模型到高级应用的路线图。核心创新包括：形式化世界模型的关键属性（如可预测性、因果性、组合性），分类现有方法（如基于Transformer的world model、基于扩散的world model），并指出关键挑战（如长期预测、抽象表示、交互学习）。该工作为跨领域协作提供了理论框架。

多模态学习.title: Demonstrating TOFFEE: A Learned System for Synthesizing Data Agent Trajectories at Scale
多模态学习.title_zh: TOFFEE演示：大规模合成数据智能体轨迹的学习系统
多模态学习.summary: LLM-powered data agents are playing an increasingly important role in data-driven decision making. However, existing data agents struggle to generalize to unseen data environments and analytical workflows, especially in heterogeneous enterprise settings. This creates a growing need for synthesizing diverse and realistic agent trajectories to train robust agents. We present TOFFEE, a learned system that generates synthetic data agent trajectories at scale. TOFFEE uses a two-stage approach: first, it learns a distribution over agent behaviors from a small set of expert demonstrations; then, it samples novel trajectories that are diverse and cover edge cases. We evaluate TOFFEE on multiple enterprise data analysis tasks and show that agents trained on TOFFEE-generated trajectories significantly outperform those trained on limited real data.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 基于LLM的数据智能体在数据驱动决策中日益重要，但现有智能体难以泛化到未见过的数据环境和工作流。本文提出TOFFEE系统，通过两阶段方法从少量专家演示中学习智能体行为分布，并采样多样化的轨迹以覆盖边界情况。实验表明，在TOFFEE生成轨迹上训练的智能体显著优于仅使用有限真实数据训练的智能体。

多模态学习.title: What Images Cannot Say: Language-Guided Olfactory Representation Learning
多模态学习.title_zh: 图像无法言说：语言引导的嗅觉表征学习
多模态学习.summary: Images tell us what a scene looks like, but rarely what it would feel like to be there. While recent datasets pair visual scenes with electronic-nose measurements, aligning smell signals with images remains challenging because many olfactory cues arise from contextual environmental factors that are not captured visually. We propose a language-guided olfactory representation learning method that leverages textual descriptions to bridge the gap between visual and olfactory modalities. Our approach uses a contrastive learning framework to align smell signals with language embeddings, enabling cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot smell prediction from images. Experiments on a real-world smell dataset demonstrate that our method outperforms vision-based baselines, highlighting the importance of language for capturing olfactory cues.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 图像能展示场景的外观，但很少能传达身处其中的感受。尽管近期数据集将视觉场景与电子鼻测量配对，但由于许多嗅觉线索源于视觉未捕获的上下文环境因素，将气味信号与图像对齐仍具挑战。本文提出一种语言引导的嗅觉表征学习方法，利用文本描述弥合视觉与嗅觉模态间的鸿沟。该方法采用对比学习框架，将气味信号与语言嵌入对齐，实现跨模态检索以及从图像进行零样本气味预测。在真实世界气味数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于基于视觉的基线，凸显了语言在捕捉嗅觉线索中的重要性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: An Experimental Design Approach to Evaluating Agentic AI's Autonomous Model Discovery
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 基于实验设计的自主模型发现评估方法
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large language model coding agents increasingly perform open-ended data modeling and analysis. These agents are stochastic and adaptive, and therefore their autonomous model discovery behavior cannot be adequately characterized by a single benchmark run. In this work, we propose an experimental design approach to evaluate the autonomous model discovery capabilities of such agents. We treat the agent's behavior as an experimental process and design a set of interventions to probe its exploration strategy. Using this framework, we analyze how agents select models, handle uncertainty, and adapt to new data. Our results provide insights into the strengths and weaknesses of current agents and suggest directions for improvement.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型编码智能体越来越多地执行开放式数据建模与分析，但其随机性和适应性导致单一基准测试无法充分表征其自主模型发现行为。本文提出一种实验设计方法，将智能体行为视为实验过程，通过一系列干预来探测其探索策略。分析结果揭示了当前智能体在模型选择、不确定性处理和适应新数据方面的优缺点，并提出了改进方向。

大语言模型/LLM.title: LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction for Trustworthy Industrial Process Inference
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 基于LLM的测量可信度校正：面向可信工业过程推理
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Industrial prediction and soft sensing depend on credible input measurements. In field deployment, a predictor may receive biased, delayed, stale, or derived measurements that still look plausible. Prediction can then fail before the forecasting backbone becomes the main limitation, because the input quality degrades. This paper proposes an LLM-guided credibility correction framework that detects and corrects unreliable measurements using contextual knowledge, improving robustness of industrial inference.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 工业预测和软测量依赖于可信的输入测量值。在实际部署中，预测器可能接收到有偏、延迟、过时或推导出的测量值，这些值看似合理但质量下降，导致预测失败。本文提出一种基于LLM引导的可信度校正框架，利用上下文知识检测并修正不可靠的测量值，从而提升工业推理的鲁棒性。创新点在于将LLM的语义理解能力用于工业测量数据的可信度评估与校正，主要贡献是显著提高了在测量异常情况下的预测准确率。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Estimating Uncertainty from Reasoning: A Large-Scale Study of Multi- and Crosslingual MCQA Performance in LLMs
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 从推理中估计不确定性：多语言与跨语言MCQA性能的大规模研究
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Uncertainty estimation (UE) enables LLM-powered systems to recognize when to abstain, yet existing research has predominantly focused on English. We present the first large-scale evaluation of UE methods across 22 languages, spanning high-, mid-, and low-resource settings. Using two human-curated QA datasets, we analyze how reasoning patterns affect uncertainty estimates and propose a novel UE approach that leverages chain-of-thought reasoning to improve calibration across languages.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 不确定性估计（UE）使基于LLM的系统能够识别何时应放弃回答，但现有研究主要聚焦英语。本文首次在22种语言（涵盖高、中、低资源场景）上大规模评估UE方法。通过两个人工精选的QA数据集，分析了推理模式如何影响不确定性估计，并提出一种利用思维链推理改进跨语言校准的新型UE方法。创新点在于跨语言UE的全面评估和基于推理的UE技术，主要贡献是揭示了语言资源对UE的影响并提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

大语言模型/LLM.title: DepthWeave-KV: Token-Adaptive Cross-Layer Residual Factorization for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: DepthWeave-KV：面向长上下文KV缓存压缩的令牌自适应跨层残差分解
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Long-context language model inference is increasingly limited by the memory bandwidth and capacity required to store key-value caches, yet existing compression methods often apply uniform budgets across layers or tokens and degrade retrieval when lexical cues and semantic states require different precision. We propose DepthWeave-KV, which adaptively compresses KV caches by factorizing residuals across layers and tokens, achieving high compression ratios while preserving retrieval quality.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 长上下文语言模型推理受限于键值缓存的存储带宽和容量，现有压缩方法常在各层或令牌间均匀分配预算，在词汇线索和语义状态需要不同精度时检索性能下降。本文提出DepthWeave-KV，通过跨层和令牌的残差分解自适应压缩KV缓存，在保持检索质量的同时实现高压缩比。创新点在于令牌自适应的跨层压缩策略，主要贡献是显著降低了长上下文推理的内存需求而不牺牲准确性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Prompt-Adapter Context Routing for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 提示适配器上下文路由：面向参数高效的多镜头长视频外推
大语言模型/LLM.summary: We present PACR-Video, a parameter-efficient framework for multi-shot long video extrapolation that preserves recurring entities, scene structure, visual style, and causal progression without full generator fine-tuning. PACR-Video keeps a text-to-video diffusion transformer frozen and augments it with lightweight prompt-adapters that route contextual information across shots, enabling consistent long video generation.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出PACR-Video，一种参数高效的多镜头长视频外推框架，无需完整生成器微调即可保持重复实体、场景结构、视觉风格和因果进程。PACR-Video冻结文本到视频扩散变换器，并通过轻量级提示适配器在镜头间路由上下文信息，实现一致的长视频生成。创新点在于参数高效的跨镜头上下文路由机制，主要贡献是显著降低了长视频生成的计算成本同时保持高一致性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Doomed from the Start: Early Abort of LLM Agent Episodes via a Recall-Controlled Probe Cascade
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 注定失败：通过召回控制探针级联提前终止LLM智能体回合
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents solving multi-step tasks frequently commit to trajectories that are doomed to fail, yet continue to consume substantial inference compute before the failure becomes observable. We show that failure is predictable early from the agent's internal representations: lightweight probes trained on hidden states can predict failure with high accuracy, and a cascade of probes with recall control enables early abort, saving compute.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 解决多步任务的LLM智能体常陷入注定失败的轨迹，但在失败显现前仍消耗大量推理计算。本文证明从智能体内部表征可早期预测失败：基于隐藏状态训练的轻量级探针能高精度预测失败，并通过带召回控制的探针级联实现提前终止以节省计算。创新点在于利用内部表征进行早期失败预测，主要贡献是显著减少了无效推理的计算浪费。

大语言模型/LLM.title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: FreqDepthKV：长上下文LLM推理中基于频率引导的深度共享鲁棒KV缓存压缩
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Long-context LLM inference is increasingly limited by the memory and bandwidth cost of KV caches, yet aggressive compression can remove the layer-specific evidence needed for retrieval and multi-step reasoning. We introduce FreqDepthKV, an inference-time cache compression method that factorizes adjacent layers into frequency and depth components, sharing frequency information across layers to reduce redundancy while preserving depth-specific details. Experiments show that FreqDepthKV achieves up to 4x compression with minimal accuracy loss, outperforming existing methods on long-context benchmarks.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 长上下文LLM推理日益受到KV缓存内存和带宽成本的限制，但激进的压缩可能移除检索和多步推理所需的层特定证据。我们提出FreqDepthKV，一种推理时缓存压缩方法，将相邻层分解为频率和深度分量，跨层共享频率信息以减少冗余，同时保留深度特定细节。实验表明，FreqDepthKV在最小精度损失下实现了高达4倍压缩，在长上下文基准上优于现有方法。

大语言模型/LLM.title: TopoBrick: Agentic Topology Sampling of Exogenous Variables for Zero-Shot Building IoT Forecasting
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: TopoBrick：面向零样本建筑物联网预测的外生变量智能拓扑采样
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Building sensors are embedded in physical topology, spatial hierarchy, and operational context, yet existing forecasters often treat them as isolated time series or rely on fixed covariate sets. We present TopoBrick, a training-free framework for zero-shot building IoT (Internet-of-Things) forecasting.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: TopoBrick是一个无需训练的零样本建筑物联网预测框架。它利用物理拓扑、空间层次和运行上下文，通过智能代理自动采样外生变量，克服了传统方法将传感器视为孤立时间序列或依赖固定协变量集的局限。主要创新包括：基于拓扑的变量选择、零样本泛化能力，以及无需重新训练的即插即用特性。该框架在多个真实建筑数据集上展现了出色的预测性能，尤其适用于数据稀缺或新建筑场景。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Data Analysis in the Wild: Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Real-World Data Complexities
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 野外数据分析：针对真实世界数据复杂性的大语言模型基准测试
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Current benchmarks for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) in data analysis often fail to reflect real-world settings. They typically focus on fact retrieval from small tables and overlook the challenges of large multi-tabular datasets, external knowledge integration, and exploratory insight discovery.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出了一个更贴近真实世界的数据分析基准测试，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）。现有基准多局限于小表格的事实检索，忽略了大型多表格数据集、外部知识整合和探索性洞察发现等挑战。新基准包含多表联合查询、外部知识融合、开放探索等任务，揭示了LLM在处理复杂数据时的不足。主要贡献：设计了反映实际数据复杂性的评估体系，并提供了详细的性能分析，为LLM在数据分析领域的应用提供了改进方向。

大语言模型/LLM.title: A toy framework for single and multi-agent human-AI curiosity ecosystems
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 单智能体与多智能体人机好奇心生态系统的玩具框架
大语言模型/LLM.summary: This paper offers a toy framework for considering curiosity as an ecosystem. First, it suggests that a single agent's inquiry policy (how, when, and why an agent asks a question) depends on how the agent values immediate uncertainty reduction, costs, delayed return, and the value of keeping the question open.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出了一个将好奇心视为生态系统的玩具框架。在单智能体场景中，智能体的提问策略取决于其对即时不确定性减少、成本、延迟回报以及保持问题开放价值的权衡。在多智能体场景中，框架进一步建模了信息共享与协作探索的动力学。主要创新：形式化了好奇心驱动下的探索与利用平衡，并为设计更自然的人机交互系统提供了理论基础。该框架虽为简化模型，但有助于理解好奇心在学习和决策中的作用。

大语言模型/LLM.title: LLM Agents for Deliberative Collaboration: A Study on Joint Decision Making Under Partial Observability
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 用于协商协作的LLM智能体：部分可观察环境下联合决策研究
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Deliberation plays a crucial role in collaboration; when humans work together, they naturally engage in communication to align information and reach an agreement. In this paper, we investigate deliberative large language model (LLM) agents under partially observable joint decision-making tasks.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文研究了在部分可观察的联合决策任务中，具备协商能力的LLM智能体。与人类协作类似，智能体需要通过沟通对齐信息并达成共识。主要创新：设计了一个多智能体协商框架，使LLM智能体能够交换观察、提出建议并进行辩论。实验表明，协商机制显著提升了决策质量和一致性，尤其在信息不对称场景下。该工作为开发更有效的多智能体协作系统提供了新思路。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Driving the Wrong Way: Leveraging Interpretability in End2End Autonomous Driving Models
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 错误驾驶：利用可解释性提升端到端自动驾驶模型
大语言模型/LLM.summary: The increasing adoption of end-to-end learning for autonomous driving introduces increased model complexity and opacity, raising the risk of learning undesired or erroneous behavior. In this work, we integrate unsupervised dictionary learning as a post hoc interpretability module within state-of-the-art end-to-end driving models.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶模型因其复杂性和黑箱特性，可能学习到不良或错误的驾驶行为。本文在先进端到端驾驶模型中集成了无监督字典学习作为事后可解释性模块。主要创新：通过字典学习提取可解释的驾驶概念（如车道保持、避障等），并可视化模型决策依据。实验发现，模型在某些情况下会学习到“错误”的驾驶模式（如逆向行驶），而可解释性有助于检测和纠正这些行为。该工作提升了自动驾驶模型的安全性和透明度。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Danus: Orchestrating Mathematical Reasoning Agents with Fact-Graph Memory
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: Danus：利用事实图记忆编排数学推理智能体
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Recent LLM-based mathematical reasoning agents have begun to tackle research-level problems and, in several cases, have contributed to the resolution of open problems. However, scaling and orchestrating such agents effectively remains challenging, due to the difficulty of coordinating parallel proof
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 近期的基于大语言模型的数学推理智能体已开始处理研究级问题，并在多个案例中为开放问题的解决做出了贡献。然而，由于协调并行证明的困难，有效扩展和编排此类智能体仍然具有挑战性。本文提出Danus系统，通过事实图记忆来组织多个数学推理智能体，使其能够协作解决复杂数学问题。创新点在于引入事实图作为共享记忆结构，有效管理智能体间的信息流和推理状态，提升了多智能体系统的协调效率和问题解决能力。主要贡献包括：设计了事实图记忆机制，实现了智能体间的动态信息共享；提出了编排策略，优化了并行推理过程；在多个数学推理基准上验证了系统的有效性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: LongCrafter: Towards Diverse Long-Context Understanding via Evidence-Graph-Guided Instruction Synthesis
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: LongCrafter：通过证据图引导的指令合成实现多样化长上下文理解
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Synthesizing long-context supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is a scalable way to enhance the long-context understanding of large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches share three limitations: narrow task coverage, insufficient instruction difficulty, and a lack of faithfulness supervision.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 合成长上下文监督微调（SFT）数据是增强大语言模型（LLM）长上下文理解能力的可扩展方法，但现有方法存在三个局限性：任务覆盖范围窄、指令难度不足以及缺乏忠实度监督。本文提出LongCrafter方法，通过证据图引导的指令合成生成多样化、高难度的长上下文SFT数据。该方法首先构建证据图以捕捉文本中的关键依赖关系，然后基于该图生成需要深度推理的复杂指令，并引入忠实度监督机制确保生成的答案与证据一致。实验表明，LongCrafter在多个长上下文基准测试上显著提升了LLM的性能，尤其擅长处理需要跨段落推理的任务。主要贡献包括：提出证据图结构用于指导长上下文指令生成，设计了基于图的任务难度控制策略，并建立了自动化的忠实度验证流程。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Improving LLM-Generated Process Model Quality Through Reinforcement Learning: The Role of Reward Function Design
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 通过强化学习提升LLM生成流程模型质量：奖励函数设计的作用
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate BPMN process models from natural-language descriptions, yet supervised fine-tuning (SFT) limits their output quality to the patterns present in the training data. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize beyond this ceiling using external quality measures, but the design of reward functions is critical. We systematically investigate the impact of different reward functions on the quality of LLM-generated BPMN models. We find that reward functions combining syntactic correctness, semantic alignment, and model complexity yield the best results. Our RL-based approach significantly outperforms SFT baselines, producing process models that are more accurate, complete, and understandable. This work provides insights into reward design for RL fine-tuning of LLMs in structured output generation tasks.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能从自然语言描述生成BPMN流程模型，但监督微调（SFT）将输出质量限制在训练数据中的模式。强化学习（RL）可利用外部质量度量超越这一上限，但奖励函数设计至关重要。本文系统研究了不同奖励函数对LLM生成BPMN模型质量的影响。我们发现，结合句法正确性、语义对齐和模型复杂度的奖励函数效果最佳。基于RL的方法显著优于SFT基线，生成的流程模型更准确、完整且易于理解。该工作为结构化输出生成任务中LLM的RL微调奖励设计提供了见解。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization: An Adaptive Tree-Structured Rollout Approach for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 基于信息增益的展开策略优化：面向多轮LLM智能体的自适应树结构展开方法
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Reinforcement learning has become a promising paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon search tasks, where the agent must make a sequence of intermediate decisions before receiving a final outcome. However, existing methods still face a key limitation: the rollout bud
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）智能体在长时域搜索任务中性能的有前景范式，此类任务中智能体需在获得最终结果前做出系列中间决策。然而，现有方法仍面临关键限制：展开预算分配不均。本文提出基于信息增益的展开策略优化（IG-RPO），一种自适应树结构展开方法，通过动态分配展开预算，优先探索信息增益高的路径。创新点包括：1）引入信息增益度量指导树搜索；2）提出自适应剪枝策略平衡探索与利用；3）在多轮对话任务中显著提升决策质量。主要贡献在于首次将信息增益与树结构展开结合，有效解决了LLM智能体在长时域任务中的预算分配问题，实验表明在多个基准上性能优于现有方法。

优化算法.title: UBEP: Re-architecting Expert Parallelism Communication Library for Production Superpods
优化算法.title_zh: UBEP：面向生产级超级节点的专家并行通信库重构
优化算法.summary: The deployment of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods, such as NVIDIA's NVL72/576 and Huawei's CloudMatrix384, introduces critical challenges beyond raw interconnect bandwidth. While these systems provide unified global address spaces and high-bandwidth fabrics, the communication patterns of expert parallelism can lead to severe contention and load imbalance. We propose UBEP, a re-architected communication library for expert parallelism that exploits the topology of superpods. UBEP uses a hierarchical communication scheme to reduce contention and a dynamic load balancing mechanism to handle skewed expert routing. Experiments on NVIDIA NVL72 show that UBEP achieves up to 2x speedup over existing implementations.
优化算法.summary_zh: 将混合专家模型部署到生产级高带宽超级节点（如NVIDIA NVL72/576）面临通信竞争和负载不均等挑战。本文提出UBEP通信库，利用超级节点拓扑结构，采用层次化通信方案减少竞争，并设计动态负载均衡机制处理偏斜的专家路由。在NVIDIA NVL72上的实验表明，UBEP相比现有实现实现了高达2倍的加速。

物理信息神经网络.title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Elastodynamic Wave Propagation in Bimaterial Systems
物理信息神经网络.title_zh: 双材料系统中弹性动力波传播的物理信息神经网络框架
物理信息神经网络.summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a promising framework for solving partial differential equations while embedding the underlying physical laws directly into the learning process. This study presents a PINN-based framework for modeling transient elastodynamic wave propagation in bimaterial systems. The key challenge is the discontinuity at the material interface, which standard PINNs struggle to capture. We introduce a domain decomposition approach with separate networks for each material and enforce continuity conditions at the interface via a penalty term. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our method accurately captures wave reflection and transmission at the interface, outperforming traditional numerical methods in terms of flexibility and computational cost for certain configurations.
物理信息神经网络.summary_zh: 物理信息神经网络为求解偏微分方程提供了有前景的框架，但标准PINNs难以处理材料界面的不连续性。本文提出基于PINNs的双材料系统瞬态弹性动力波传播建模框架，采用区域分解方法为每种材料分配独立网络，并通过惩罚项强制执行界面连续性条件。数值实验表明，该方法准确捕捉了界面处的波反射和透射，在灵活性和计算成本方面优于传统数值方法。

LLM & Code Generation.title: RuBench: A Repository-Level Agentic Coding Benchmark with Natively Authored Russian Task Specifications
LLM & Code Generation.title_zh: RuBench：一个具有原生俄语任务规范的仓库级智能编码基准
LLM & Code Generation.summary: Developers increasingly delegate real maintenance work to product-grade coding agents, and many state tasks in their native language, in the style of a customer request rather than a curated English issue. Existing repository-level agentic benchmarks do not measure this setting: their task statements are in English and curated by researchers. We introduce RuBench, a repository-level agentic coding benchmark with natively authored Russian task specifications. RuBench contains 50 real-world maintenance tasks from 7 open-source repositories, each written in Russian by native speakers. We evaluate several state-of-the-art coding agents on RuBench and find that they struggle with Russian-language tasks, achieving at most 22% success rate. We release RuBench to facilitate research on multilingual and culturally aware coding agents.
LLM & Code Generation.summary_zh: RuBench是一个针对仓库级智能编码代理的基准测试，其独特之处在于所有任务规范均以俄语原生编写，模拟真实场景中开发者使用母语描述需求。现有基准测试大多使用英语任务，无法评估多语言环境下的编码代理性能。RuBench包含来自7个开源仓库的50个真实维护任务，由母语者编写。实验表明，最先进的编码代理在RuBench上成功率仅22%，揭示了当前模型在多语言和跨文化编码任务中的不足。该基准促进了多语言感知编码代理的研究。

Reinforcement Learning / Game AI.title: FootsiesGym: A Fighting Game Benchmark for Two-Player Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
Reinforcement Learning / Game AI.title_zh: FootsiesGym：用于双人零和不完美信息格斗游戏的基准测试
Reinforcement Learning / Game AI.summary: We present FootsiesGym, an open-source environment for learning in a non-trivial two-player, zero-sum, imperfect-information game. Built on HiFight's minimalist 2D fighting game Footsies, it isolates the cyclic, non-transitive strategic interactions of fighting game neutral play while remaining simple enough for rapid prototyping. The environment provides a Gymnasium-compatible API, supports multiple learning paradigms (self-play, population-based training), and includes precomputed Nash equilibrium baselines. We demonstrate that agents trained with standard deep RL algorithms can learn effective strategies, but fail to achieve Nash equilibrium, highlighting the challenge of learning in cyclic strategic spaces.
Reinforcement Learning / Game AI.summary_zh: FootsiesGym是一个基于HiFight的极简格斗游戏Footsies构建的开源环境，专为双人零和不完美信息游戏设计。它保留了格斗游戏中循环、非传递的战略互动特性，同时简化以便快速原型开发。环境兼容Gymnasium API，支持自对弈、基于种群的训练等多种学习范式，并提供了预计算的纳什均衡基线。实验表明，标准深度强化学习算法训练的智能体虽能学到有效策略，但无法达到纳什均衡，凸显了在循环策略空间中学习的挑战。该基准有助于研究不完美信息博弈中的战略推理。

Audio Processing.title: TriA Pipeline: A Large-Scale Automatic Audio Annotation Pipeline For Audio Classification In Specific Scenarios
Audio Processing.title_zh: TriA Pipeline：用于特定场景音频分类的大规模自动音频标注流水线
Audio Processing.summary: There are some datasets of varying scales for audio classification (AC) applied to different tasks. However, annotated data is limited for most scenarios, such as domestic environments. To address this challenge, we propose an Automatic Audio Annotation Pipeline--TriA. TriA leverages a three-stage process: (1) audio event detection using a pretrained model, (2) semantic filtering via text-audio alignment, and (3) iterative refinement with active learning. We demonstrate that TriA can generate high-quality annotations for domestic audio scenes, achieving comparable performance to human-annotated data while reducing annotation cost by orders of magnitude. The pipeline is scalable and can be adapted to various specific scenarios.
Audio Processing.summary_zh: TriA Pipeline是一个大规模自动音频标注流水线，针对特定场景（如家庭环境）中标注数据稀缺的问题。它采用三阶段流程：基于预训练模型的音频事件检测、通过文本-音频对齐的语义过滤、以及主动学习迭代优化。实验表明，TriA生成的标注质量与人工标注相当，但成本降低了几个数量级。该流水线可扩展，适用于多种特定场景的音频分类任务，显著降低了数据标注的门槛。

Vision-Language Models / Embodied AI.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
Vision-Language Models / Embodied AI.title_zh: 通过视觉动作结果推理对齐桥接物理推理与任务泛化
Vision-Language Models / Embodied AI.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to generalize in interactive physical reasoning, particularly under unseen tasks and environments. Two key failure modes are prominent: hallucinated chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that contradicts physical reality, and misalignment between the model's reasoning and actual action outcomes. We propose a novel framework, Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment (VAORA), which aligns VLM reasoning with visual feedback of action outcomes. VAORA introduces a self-supervised reward signal based on the consistency between predicted and observed outcomes, and fine-tunes VLMs using reinforcement learning. Experiments on physical reasoning benchmarks show that VAORA significantly improves task generalization, reducing hallucination and improving success rate by over 30% compared to baselines.
Vision-Language Models / Embodied AI.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在交互式物理推理中泛化能力弱，主要问题包括：与物理现实矛盾的幻觉式思维链，以及模型推理与实际动作结果之间的错位。本文提出视觉动作结果推理对齐框架（VAORA），通过将模型推理与动作结果的视觉反馈对齐来解决该问题。VAORA利用预测结果与观察结果之间的一致性作为自监督奖励信号，并使用强化学习微调视觉语言模型。在物理推理基准上，VAORA显著提升了任务泛化能力，将幻觉减少并提高了30%以上的成功率。

Prediction Markets / Game Theory.title: When do prophets profit in prediction markets?
Prediction Markets / Game Theory.title_zh: 预言家何时在预测市场中获利？
Prediction Markets / Game Theory.summary: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed beliefs into prices that act as probabilistic forecasts of uncertain events. Classical theory establishes a clean equivalence between forecasting accuracy and trading profit, but only for the specific automated market maker (AMM) design. However, the largest existing prediction markets (e.g., PredictIt, Kalshi) use order-book mechanisms rather than AMMs. We analyze profit conditions for informed traders in order-book prediction markets. We show that even with perfect information, a trader may lose money due to bid-ask spreads and market impact. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for profitable trading, and propose a simple strategy that guarantees profit for well-informed traders. Our results highlight the importance of market microstructure for prediction market accuracy.
Prediction Markets / Game Theory.summary_zh: 预测市场通过价格聚合分散信念，以预测不确定事件。经典理论认为预测准确性与交易利润等价，但仅适用于自动做市商（AMM）设计。然而，现有大型预测市场（如PredictIt、Kalshi）使用订单簿机制而非AMM。本文分析了知情交易者在订单簿预测市场中的获利条件，发现即使拥有完美信息，交易者也可能因买卖价差和市场冲击而亏损。研究推导了盈利交易的充要条件，并提出一种简单策略确保知情交易者获利。结果强调了市场微观结构对预测准确性的重要性。

强化学习/RL.title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi Objective Battery Management in Dairy Farms
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 面向奶牛场多目标电池管理的多智能体深度强化学习
强化学习/RL.summary: The dairy industry in Ireland has a large potential for the integration of renewable energy and the reduction of carbon emissions. However, researchers of distributed generation control are mainly focused on residential and commercial applications. To contribute to the effective integration of renewable energy and battery storage in dairy farms, this paper proposes a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) approach for multi-objective battery management. The agents learn to coordinate charging/discharging decisions to minimize electricity cost, reduce carbon emissions, and extend battery lifetime. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms rule-based baselines in all objectives.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 爱尔兰奶牛业在可再生能源整合和碳排放减少方面具有巨大潜力，但分布式发电控制的研究主要集中于住宅和商业应用。为促进奶牛场中可再生能源和电池存储的有效整合，本文提出了一种面向多目标电池管理的多智能体深度强化学习方法。智能体学习协调充放电决策，以最小化电力成本、减少碳排放并延长电池寿命。仿真结果表明，该方法在所有目标上均优于基于规则的基线方法。

NLP.title: From Voting to Agent Collaboration: Answer-Type-Aware LLM Pipelines for BioASQ 14b
NLP.title_zh: 从投票到智能体协作：面向BioASQ 14b的答案类型感知LLM流水线
NLP.summary: Biomedical question answering requires not only accurate extraction of information from scientific literature but also reliable integration of evidence across multiple documents. This study presents a question-type-specific large language model (LLM) framework for BioASQ 14b Task B, designed to improve answer accuracy by leveraging answer-type-aware pipelines. The framework uses different strategies for factoid, list, and summary questions, incorporating multi-agent collaboration and voting mechanisms. Experimental results show significant improvements over baseline LLMs, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the BioASQ 14b benchmark.
NLP.summary_zh: 生物医学问答不仅需要从科学文献中准确提取信息，还需要跨多个文档可靠地整合证据。本研究提出了一个面向BioASQ 14b任务B的答案类型感知大语言模型框架，通过利用答案类型感知流水线来提高答案准确性。该框架针对事实型、列表型和摘要型问题采用不同策略，并结合多智能体协作与投票机制。实验结果表明，该方法显著优于基线LLM，在BioASQ 14b基准上达到了最先进性能。

NLP.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
NLP.title_zh: RSF-GLLM：通过循环软流和解耦LLM生成弥合多跳知识图谱问答中的语义鸿沟
NLP.summary: Multi-hop Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs faces a critical challenge: traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines break differentiability, preventing the retriever from learning to bridge the semantic gap where intermediate nodes lack lexical overlap with the query. To address this, we propose
NLP.summary_zh: 知识图谱上的多跳问答面临关键挑战：传统的检索-读取流程破坏了可微性，导致检索器无法学习弥合中间节点与查询之间缺乏词汇重叠的语义鸿沟。本文提出RSF-GLLM，一种循环软流机制，通过可微的软检索和循环传播，使检索器能够端到端学习，同时利用解耦的LLM生成模块提高推理准确性。该方法有效弥合了语义鸿沟，在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果，显著提升了多跳问答的性能。

NLP.title: Rethinking Indic AI from a Lens of Cultural Heritage Preservation
NLP.title_zh: 从文化遗产保护视角重新思考印度人工智能
NLP.summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) makes inroads into different parts of the Indian subcontinent, there is significant interest in studying how AI impacts the linguistic and cultural foundations of this civilization. AI is seen as a 'double-edged sword' where on the one hand, it can enable access and preservation of cultural heritage, but on the other hand, it may homogenize or erode unique cultural expressions. This paper examines the challenges and opportunities of applying AI to Indic languages and cultures, proposing a framework for culturally-aware AI systems that prioritize preservation over replacement. We discuss case studies in language modeling, digitization of manuscripts, and oral traditions, highlighting the need for community involvement and ethical guidelines.
NLP.summary_zh: 随着人工智能进入印度次大陆的不同地区，研究AI如何影响该文明的语言和文化基础引起了广泛关注。AI被视为一把“双刃剑”：一方面，它可以促进文化遗产的获取和保护；另一方面，它可能同化或侵蚀独特的文化表达。本文审视了将AI应用于印度语言和文化所面临的挑战与机遇，提出了一个文化感知AI系统框架，优先考虑保护而非替代。我们讨论了语言建模、手稿数字化和口头传统等案例研究，强调了社区参与和伦理准则的必要性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: AirflowAttack: Thermal-Airflow Adversarial Perturbations against Infrared Remote-Sensing Vision-Language Models
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: AirflowAttack：针对红外遥感视觉语言模型的热气流对抗扰动
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed on infrared (IR) remote sensing imagery in security-critical settings, yet their adversarial robustness remains unexamined. We present AirflowAttack, to our knowledge the first adversarial attack for IR remote-sensing VLMs and the first to weaponize thermal airflow as a physical adversarial perturbation. By modeling thermal airflow dynamics, we generate adversarial examples that cause misclassification in VLMs. Experiments on real-world IR datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the attack, highlighting vulnerabilities in current models.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型日益部署于安全关键场景的红外遥感图像中，但其对抗鲁棒性尚未被检验。我们提出AirflowAttack，据我们所知，这是首个针对红外遥感视觉语言模型的对抗攻击，也是首个将热气流作为物理对抗扰动武器化的方法。通过建模热气流动力学，我们生成导致视觉语言模型误分类的对抗样本。在真实红外数据集上的实验证明了该攻击的有效性，揭示了当前模型的脆弱性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: RoME: Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts against Multiple Adversarial Perturbations
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: RoME：针对多种对抗性扰动的鲁棒低秩专家混合模型
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Multi-perturbation adversarial training (MAT) aims to achieve robustness against multiple ℓ_p perturbations but suffers from robustness trade-offs between different threats. To address this, we employ a mixture of experts (MoE) to route different threats through distinct model pathways. However
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 多扰动对抗训练旨在针对多种ℓ_p扰动实现鲁棒性，但面临不同威胁之间的鲁棒性权衡问题。为此，本文采用专家混合模型将不同威胁路由至不同的模型路径。然而，标准MoE在对抗训练中会导致专家退化。本文提出RoME，一种鲁棒的低秩专家混合模型，通过低秩适配和正则化技术，在保持参数高效的同时，有效缓解专家退化，显著提升多扰动鲁棒性。实验表明，RoME在多个基准上优于现有方法，实现了更好的鲁棒性平衡。

计算机视觉/CV.title: PVCap: Towards Accurate 3D Dense Captioning via PseudoCap and VoxelCapNet
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: PVCap：通过PseudoCap和VoxelCapNet实现精确的3D密集描述
计算机视觉/CV.summary: 3D dense captioning, an emerging vision-language task, aims to generate descriptive sentences for each object in the 3D scene. Despite the impressive results achieved by previous methods, they suffer from two limitations. First, current research often employs global rigid transformations, such as ro
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 3D密集描述是一项新兴的视觉语言任务，旨在为3D场景中的每个物体生成描述性句子。现有方法虽取得显著成果，但存在两个局限：一是常使用全局刚性变换（如旋转），导致物体定位不准确；二是缺乏大规模标注数据。本文提出PVCap，包含PseudoCap自动标注框架和VoxelCapNet网络。PseudoCap利用多视图图像生成伪标注，缓解数据稀缺问题。VoxelCapNet采用体素化特征提取和注意力机制，实现更精确的物体定位和描述生成。在ScanRefer等数据集上，PVCap显著提升了描述准确性和细粒度。

计算机视觉/CV.title: VendorBench-100: A Unified Cross-Paradigm Benchmark for Deepfake Image Detection
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: VendorBench-100：深度伪造图像检测的统一跨范式基准
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Deepfake image detection is currently served by three fundamentally different paradigms: commercial APIs, zero-shot vision-language models (LLMs), and open-source detectors. Despite their widespread use, these paradigms are rarely evaluated under a common protocol, making direct comparison difficult
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 深度伪造图像检测目前存在三种根本不同的范式：商业API、零样本视觉语言模型和开源检测器。尽管它们被广泛使用，但很少在统一协议下评估，导致直接比较困难。本文提出VendorBench-100，一个统一的跨范式基准，包含100个多样化数据集和标准化评估协议。通过系统评估，揭示了各范式的优缺点：商业API在特定场景表现优异，零样本模型泛化能力强，开源检测器可定制性高。该基准为深度伪造检测提供了全面的比较平台，有助于推动领域发展。

计算机视觉/CV.title: EcoVision: AI-Powered Drone Imaging for Salt Marsh Vegetation Monitoring and Dominance Mapping
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: EcoVision：基于人工智能的无人机成像用于盐沼植被监测与优势度制图
计算机视觉/CV.summary: High-resolution RGB imagery acquired from low-altitude UAV surveys was processed through a modular pipeline incorporating transformer-based semantic segmentation, connected-component vegetation extraction, fine-grained species classification using a ConvNeXt architecture, and grid-based dominance sc
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文提出EcoVision系统，利用低空无人机获取的高分辨率RGB图像，通过模块化流水线进行盐沼植被监测与优势度制图。该流水线集成了基于Transformer的语义分割、连通分量植被提取、基于ConvNeXt架构的细粒度物种分类以及基于网格的优势度评分。创新点在于结合了多种深度学习技术，实现了对盐沼植被的高精度自动识别与分布制图。主要贡献包括：设计了端到端的无人机图像处理流程，提高了监测效率；提出了细粒度物种分类方法，准确区分了不同植被类型；通过优势度制图，为生态评估提供了量化依据。实验结果表明，该系统在多个指标上优于传统方法。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Analysis-by-Proxy: Localization Signals in VLMs Operating as Condition Encoders
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 代理分析：视觉语言模型作为条件编码器中的定位信号
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly utilized as the conditioning backbone for diffusion-based image editing due to their remarkable multimodal reasoning capabilities. While standalone VLMs demonstrate strong localization capabilities, editing pipelines frequently struggle to maintain this
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）因其卓越的多模态推理能力，越来越多地被用作基于扩散的图像编辑的条件主干。尽管独立的VLM表现出强大的定位能力，但编辑流水线常常难以保持这种定位精度。本文提出“代理分析”方法，研究VLM在作为条件编码器时如何传递定位信号。创新点在于揭示了VLM内部定位机制与编辑任务之间的不匹配问题，并提出了改进方案。主要贡献包括：系统分析了VLM在不同编辑场景下的定位信号行为；识别了导致定位失效的关键因素；设计了增强定位一致性的方法。实验表明，该方法能显著提升图像编辑的准确性和保真度。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Token-Based Dual-view Fusion and Adaptation of Large Vision Models for Breast Cancer Classification
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 基于Token的双视角融合与大视觉模型自适应在乳腺癌分类中的应用
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Accurate breast cancer classification from mammography requires effective integration of complementary information from craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views, which provide a more complete characterization of breast abnormalities. However, existing multi-view learning approaches typ
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 基于乳腺X线摄影的准确乳腺癌分类需要有效整合头尾位（CC）和内外斜位（MLO）的互补信息，以更完整地描述乳腺异常。然而，现有多视角学习方法通常采用简单拼接或注意力机制，未能充分利用视角间的相关性。本文提出基于Token的双视角融合与自适应方法，创新点包括：1）设计双视角Token化策略，将每个视角编码为独立Token序列；2）引入跨视角注意力融合模块，动态捕捉视角间依赖关系；3）结合大视觉模型（如ViT）进行参数高效微调。主要贡献在于提出了一种新颖的双视角融合框架，显著提升了乳腺癌分类的准确性和鲁棒性，在多个公开数据集上达到最优性能。

人机交互/HCI.title: Agents That Teach: Towards Designing Incidental Learning Back into AI-Assisted Software Development
人机交互/HCI.title_zh: 会教学智能体：将附带学习重新设计回AI辅助软件开发
人机交互/HCI.summary: AI coding agents are rapidly reshaping how software is built, with developers increasingly delegating substantial coding tasks to autonomous agents in pursuit of higher productivity. While these gains are real, they come at the cost of incidental learning. Developers historically acquired informal knowledge through hands-on coding, but AI agents reduce these opportunities. This paper proposes design principles for AI coding agents that support incidental learning, enabling developers to acquire knowledge while benefiting from automation. A user study shows that the proposed agent improves learning outcomes without sacrificing productivity.
人机交互/HCI.summary_zh: AI编码智能体正迅速重塑软件开发方式，开发者越来越多地将大量编码任务委托给自主智能体以追求更高生产力。虽然这些收益是真实的，但代价是附带学习的丧失。开发者历史上通过动手编码获得非正式知识，但AI智能体减少了这些机会。本文提出了支持附带学习的AI编码智能体设计原则，使开发者能够在受益于自动化的同时获取知识。用户研究表明，所提出的智能体在不牺牲生产力的前提下提高了学习效果。

软件工程.title: Static Metrics Are Insufficient: Predicting Java Method Energy Usage with Execution Time
软件工程.title_zh: 静态指标不足：使用执行时间预测Java方法能耗
软件工程.summary: The increasing energy demand of software systems is raising concerns about their environmental impact and associated costs. Reasoning on energy usage early in the development flow has the potential to significantly reduce the overall energy usage of a software system, as it allows developers to make informed decisions. This paper investigates the effectiveness of static code metrics versus execution time in predicting the energy consumption of Java methods. Through extensive experiments on a large dataset, we find that static metrics alone are insufficient, while execution time is a strong predictor. We propose a hybrid model that combines both features, achieving high accuracy for energy prediction.
软件工程.summary_zh: 软件系统日益增长的能源需求引发了对环境影响和相关成本的担忧。在开发流程早期推理能源使用情况有可能显著降低软件系统的总能耗，因为它允许开发者做出明智的决策。本文研究了静态代码指标与执行时间在预测Java方法能耗方面的有效性。通过在大型数据集上的大量实验，我们发现仅靠静态指标是不够的，而执行时间是一个强有力的预测因子。我们提出了一种结合两者的混合模型，实现了高精度的能耗预测。

软件工程.title: UI2App: Benchmarking Visual Interaction Inference in Executable Web Application Generation
软件工程.title_zh: UI2App：可执行Web应用生成中的视觉交互推断基准测试
软件工程.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated growing competence in web page generation. However, existing text-driven approaches rely on complex prompts that impose substantial demands on users and offer limited expressivity for page layout and cross-page visual coherence. Image-driven paradigms,
软件工程.summary_zh: 大语言模型在网页生成方面展现出日益增长的能力，但现有文本驱动方法依赖复杂提示，对用户要求高，且在页面布局和跨页视觉连贯性方面表达力有限。图像驱动范式有望缓解这些问题。本文提出UI2App基准测试，评估从用户界面（UI）截图推断视觉交互并生成可执行Web应用的能力。核心创新包括：构建包含多页面交互的UI截图数据集，定义从视觉元素到代码生成的推理任务，并设计评估指标衡量生成应用的功能完整性、视觉保真度和交互正确性。实验表明，现有模型在理解复杂UI布局和跨页面导航方面仍有较大差距。主要贡献：为视觉驱动Web生成提供了标准化评估框架，揭示了当前方法的不足，并指出了未来研究方向。

软件工程.title: Property-Driven Synthetic Data Engineering for Data-Scarce Software Systems: Reflections from the Breast Cancer Domain
软件工程.title_zh: 属性驱动的合成数据工程用于数据稀缺软件系统：来自乳腺癌领域的反思
软件工程.summary: Modern software systems increasingly depend on data for analysis, prediction, testing, and decision-making. Yet many important domains, including medicine, safety-critical systems, and regulated industries, lack abundant, shareable, or representative data. Synthetic data generation is often proposed
软件工程.summary_zh: 现代软件系统越来越依赖数据进行分析、预测、测试和决策。然而，许多重要领域（包括医学、安全关键系统和受监管行业）缺乏充足、可共享或代表性的数据。合成数据生成常被提出作为解决方案，但现有方法往往未考虑特定领域属性。本文提出属性驱动的合成数据工程方法，以乳腺癌领域为例，通过定义关键数据属性（如临床相关性、统计分布、隐私约束）来指导数据生成。核心创新包括：建立属性规范框架，将领域知识融入生成过程；设计基于生成对抗网络和约束优化的混合方法；并开发评估指标验证合成数据的实用性和保真度。案例研究表明，该方法能生成高质量合成数据，有效支持下游任务。主要贡献：为数据稀缺场景提供了系统化工程方法论，并展示了在医疗领域的实际应用价值。

图神经网络.title: Graph Convolutional Attention: A Spectral Perspective on Graph Denoising and Diffusion
图神经网络.title_zh: 图卷积注意力：图去噪与扩散的谱视角
图神经网络.summary: Denoising graphs is a fundamental problem in graph learning and the core operation of graph diffusion models. Attention-based architectures like graph transformers have recently shown promise in denoising graphs. However, our principled understanding of attention-based graph denoising remains limited. This paper provides a spectral analysis of attention mechanisms on graphs, revealing that they perform a form of graph denoising by attenuating high-frequency components. Based on this insight, we propose Graph Convolutional Attention (GCA), which integrates convolution and attention to achieve superior denoising and diffusion performance. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that GCA outperforms existing methods.
图神经网络.summary_zh: 图去噪是图学习中的一个基本问题，也是图扩散模型的核心操作。基于注意力的架构（如图Transformer）最近在图去噪中显示出潜力。然而，我们对基于注意力的图去噪的原理性理解仍然有限。本文对图上的注意力机制进行了谱分析，揭示其通过衰减高频分量来实现一种图去噪形式。基于这一见解，我们提出了图卷积注意力（GCA），它集成了卷积和注意力，以实现更优的去噪和扩散性能。在多个基准上的实验表明，GCA优于现有方法。

大语言模型.title: DT-Guard: Intent-Driven Reasoning-Active Training for Reasoning-Free LLM Safety Guardrail
大语言模型.title_zh: DT-Guard：面向无推理LLM安全护栏的意图驱动推理主动训练
大语言模型.summary: Large language models deployed in open-world applications require safety guardrails that are both robust to complex risks and efficient enough for low-latency runtime moderation. Existing guardrails face a practical trade-off between lightweight classification-based models, which are efficient but often miss nuanced attacks, and heavy reasoning-based models, which are accurate but computationally expensive. This paper proposes DT-Guard, a novel intent-driven reasoning-active training framework that distills reasoning capabilities into a lightweight classifier via a teacher-student paradigm. The student model learns to mimic the teacher's reasoning process without explicit reasoning at inference time, achieving high accuracy with low latency. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show DT-Guard outperforms both classification and reasoning baselines.
大语言模型.summary_zh: 部署在开放世界应用中的大型语言模型需要安全护栏，既要对复杂风险具有鲁棒性，又要足够高效以实现低延迟的运行时审核。现有的护栏在轻量级分类模型（高效但常忽略细微攻击）和重型推理模型（准确但计算昂贵）之间存在实际权衡。本文提出DT-Guard，一种新颖的意图驱动推理主动训练框架，通过教师-学生范式将推理能力蒸馏到轻量级分类器中。学生模型在推理时无需显式推理即可模仿教师的推理过程，实现了高精度和低延迟。在多个基准上的实验表明，DT-Guard优于分类和推理基线方法。

软件工程/SW.title: Industry Classification of GitHub Repositories Using the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)
软件工程/SW.title_zh: 使用北美产业分类体系对GitHub仓库进行行业分类
软件工程/SW.summary: GitHub hosts hundreds of millions of public repositories, but the platform exposes no native mapping from repositories to standardized industry sectors. This gap limits empirical work on the geography of innovation, the industrial composition of open-source production, and the diffusion of new techn
软件工程/SW.summary_zh: GitHub托管了数亿个公共仓库，但该平台没有提供从仓库到标准化行业部门的原生映射。这一差距限制了关于创新地理、开源生产的行业构成以及新技术扩散的实证研究。本文提出利用北美产业分类体系（NAICS）对GitHub仓库进行行业分类的方法。创新点在于将自然语言处理技术应用于仓库元数据，实现了自动化的行业分类。主要贡献包括：构建了标注数据集；设计了基于多模态特征（如仓库描述、README、语言等）的分类模型；在多个指标上达到了高精度。该工作为开源生态系统的经济学和社会学分析提供了基础工具。

自然语言处理/NLP.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
自然语言处理/NLP.title_zh: Pitwall：来自校准实时蒙特卡洛引擎的忠实自然语言比赛策略简报
自然语言处理/NLP.summary: Live sports commentary is grounded generation under a deadline: statements concern real, named athletes, the grounding state changes every few seconds, and no reference text exists at generation time. We present Pitwall, a production system that generates natural-language Formula 1 strategy briefing
自然语言处理/NLP.summary_zh: 实时体育评论是一种在截止时间下的有依据生成：陈述涉及真实的有名运动员，依据状态每几秒变化一次，且生成时没有参考文本。本文提出Pitwall，一个生产级系统，能够生成自然语言的一级方程式策略简报。创新点在于结合了校准的实时蒙特卡洛引擎与自然语言生成技术，确保简报的忠实性和时效性。主要贡献包括：设计了实时数据驱动的内容规划模块；提出了基于校准概率的置信度评估方法；实现了动态语言生成，适应比赛状态变化。该系统在真实比赛环境中进行了部署和评估，证明了其在实际应用中的有效性和可靠性。

智能体/Agent.title: Task Decomposition-Guided Reranking for Adaptive Agent Skill Retrieval
智能体/Agent.title_zh: 任务分解引导的重排序用于自适应智能体技能检索
智能体/Agent.summary: Skill usage can significantly enhance the ability of modern agent systems to complete complex tasks. However, the growing scale of skill libraries makes accurate skill selection increasingly challenging. In real-world scenarios, ambiguous semantic matching often arises between a specific task requir
智能体/Agent.summary_zh: 技能使用能显著增强现代智能体系统完成复杂任务的能力。然而，技能库规模的不断增长使得准确选择技能变得越来越具有挑战性。在真实场景中，特定任务需求与技能描述之间常出现模糊的语义匹配。本文提出任务分解引导的重排序方法，通过将任务分解为子任务，并利用分解结果对候选技能进行重排序，从而提升技能检索的准确性。核心创新包括：将任务分解与技能检索相结合，设计基于分解的语义对齐机制，以及自适应重排序策略。实验表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上优于传统检索方法，尤其在处理复杂任务时表现突出。主要贡献：提出了一种新颖的技能检索范式，有效缓解了语义歧义问题，并提升了智能体系统的自适应能力。

软件工程/AI安全.title: Evaluating Fine-Tuning and Metrics for Neural Decompilation of Dart AOT Binaries
软件工程/AI安全.title_zh: 评估Dart AOT二进制神经反编译的微调与指标
软件工程/AI安全.summary: Neural decompilation is increasingly studied as a code-generation problem, yet its evaluation methodology remains underdeveloped for modern languages. We present a systematic empirical study of fine-tuning effectiveness and metric validity for Dart Ahead-of-Time (AOT) neural decompilation. We evaluate various fine-tuning strategies on a large corpus of Dart AOT binaries and assess the correlation of standard code-generation metrics (e.g., BLEU, CodeBLEU, exact match) with human-judged correctness. Our results show that fine-tuning significantly improves decompilation accuracy, and that existing metrics have limited reliability for measuring functional correctness. We propose a new metric, Functional Match, which better aligns with human evaluation. This work provides guidelines for evaluating neural decompilation systems and highlights the need for language-specific adaptations.
软件工程/AI安全.summary_zh: 神经反编译作为代码生成问题日益受到研究，但其对现代语言的评估方法尚不成熟。本文对Dart提前编译（AOT）二进制文件的神经反编译进行了系统的微调有效性和指标有效性实证研究。我们在大规模Dart AOT二进制语料库上评估了多种微调策略，并考察了标准代码生成指标（如BLEU、CodeBLEU、精确匹配）与人工判断正确性的相关性。结果表明，微调显著提升了反编译准确率，而现有指标在衡量功能正确性方面可靠性有限。我们提出新指标Functional Match，它与人工评估更一致。该工作为评估神经反编译系统提供了指导，并强调了针对特定语言进行调整的必要性。

生成模型/加速推理.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need: Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
生成模型/加速推理.title_zh: x预测即一切：通过端点可解码性实现免训练加速生成
生成模型/加速推理.summary: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through distillation or guidance. We propose a training-free acceleration method that leverages the observation that the endpoint of the ODE trajectory is often already decodable into a meaningful sample before full convergence. By predicting the final sample (x-prediction) from intermediate states and decoding early, we significantly reduce NFEs without retraining or modifying the original model. Our method is compatible with various samplers and achieves up to 4x speedup on ImageNet 256x256 generation with minimal quality loss. This work offers a simple yet effective plug-and-play solution for accelerating pre-trained diffusion models.
生成模型/加速推理.summary_zh: 扩散模型和流匹配模型能生成高质量样本，但其ODE采样器通常需要数十到数百次神经函数评估（NFE）。这对已发布检查点构成实际挑战，因为许多加速器需要额外设计选择并通过蒸馏或指导增加训练成本。本文提出一种免训练加速方法，基于观察：ODE轨迹的终点在完全收敛前往往已可解码为有意义样本。通过从中间状态预测最终样本（x预测）并提前解码，我们显著减少NFE而无需重新训练或修改原始模型。该方法兼容多种采样器，在ImageNet 256x256生成上实现高达4倍加速，质量损失极小。该工作为加速预训练扩散模型提供了简单有效的即插即用解决方案。

AI在医疗中的应用.title: Finding H. pylori in the Fine Print: Evidence-Linked Multi-Agent Case Finding from Gastric Biopsy Reports
AI在医疗中的应用.title_zh: 在细则中发现幽门螺杆菌：基于证据链接的多智能体病例发现方法在胃活检报告中的应用
AI在医疗中的应用.summary: Data from Singapore indicated that about 31% of the population had evidence of Helicobacter pylori infection. Persistent H. pylori infection is associated with chronic active gastritis and peptic ulcer disease, and its eradication is key to gastric cancer prevention. However, evidence supporting treatment is often buried in unstructured clinical text. We propose a multi-agent AI system that extracts evidence of H. pylori infection from gastric biopsy reports and links it to clinical guidelines. The system uses specialized agents for information extraction, evidence linking, and case finding, achieving high precision and recall on a large dataset of pathology reports. This work demonstrates the potential of AI to improve clinical decision support by automatically identifying patients who may benefit from treatment.
AI在医疗中的应用.summary_zh: 新加坡数据显示约31%的人口有幽门螺杆菌感染证据。持续性幽门螺杆菌感染与慢性活动性胃炎和消化性溃疡相关，根除感染是预防胃癌的关键。然而，支持治疗证据常埋藏于非结构化临床文本中。本文提出一种多智能体AI系统，从胃活检报告中提取幽门螺杆菌感染证据并将其与临床指南链接。系统使用专门智能体进行信息提取、证据链接和病例发现，在大型病理报告数据集上实现了高精确率和召回率。该工作展示了AI通过自动识别可能从治疗中获益的患者来改进临床决策支持的潜力。

时间序列基础模型.title: RMISC: A Large-scale Real-world Multivariate Corpus for Time Series Foundation Models
时间序列基础模型.title_zh: RMISC：面向时间序列基础模型的大规模真实世界多变量语料库
时间序列基础模型.summary: Recent years have witnessed the emergence of multivariate modeling using time series foundation models (TSFMs), which achieve advanced zero-shot generalization. Modern multivariate TSFMs are predominantly pretrained on multivariate synthetic data, which is easier to scale but may fail to capture the
时间序列基础模型.summary_zh: 近年来，基于时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）的多变量建模取得了显著进展，实现了先进的零样本泛化能力。现代多变量TSFMs主要依赖多变量合成数据进行预训练，虽然易于扩展但可能无法捕捉真实世界的复杂模式。本文提出RMISC，一个大规模真实世界多变量时间序列语料库，涵盖多个领域。核心创新包括：1）构建了首个大规模真实世界多变量数据集，包含丰富的异质时间序列；2）系统分析了合成数据与真实数据之间的差异；3）提供了标准化评估基准。主要贡献在于填补了真实世界多变量时间序列数据的空白，为TSFMs的预训练和评估提供了可靠资源，实验表明基于RMISC训练的模型在零样本泛化任务上表现更优。

可解释AI/XAI.title: ExplAIner: A Declarative Query Language for Explaining Classification Models
可解释AI/XAI.title_zh: ExplAIner：用于解释分类模型的声明式查询语言
可解释AI/XAI.summary: The XAI community has studied a wide range of queries and scores for explaining predictions of ML models. From a data management perspective, this proliferation of explanation notions calls for declarative query languages in which such notions can be specified, combined, and analyzed uniformly. In t
可解释AI/XAI.summary_zh: 可解释AI（XAI）社区已研究了大量用于解释机器学习模型预测的查询和评分方法。从数据管理视角看，解释概念的激增需要一种声明式查询语言，以便统一指定、组合和分析这些概念。本文提出ExplAIner，一种新颖的声明式查询语言，专门用于解释分类模型。核心创新包括：1）设计了一套简洁的查询语法，支持多种解释原语（如反事实、贡献度、重要性等）；2）实现了查询优化引擎，高效处理复杂解释查询；3）提供统一接口，兼容多种ML模型。主要贡献在于为XAI领域提供了首个声明式查询框架，大幅降低了定义和组合解释的复杂度，实验表明其在表达力和效率上均优于现有方法。

人机交互/机器人.title: Responsible Personalisation: The Double-Edged Sword of Personalisation in Human-Robot Interaction
人机交互/机器人.title_zh: 负责任的个性化：人机交互中个性化的双刃剑效应
人机交互/机器人.summary: While personalisation is becoming a defining capability in human-robot interaction (HRI), the existing literature on responsible personalisation remains fragmented, offering isolated accounts of ethical risks without a structured understanding of how they emerge across interaction contexts. This gap
人机交互/机器人.summary_zh: 尽管个性化正成为人机交互（HRI）中的关键能力，但现有关于负责任的个性化的文献仍较为零散，仅提供孤立的伦理风险描述，缺乏对风险在不同交互情境中如何产生的结构性理解。本文系统探讨了HRI中个性化的双刃剑效应，创新点包括：1）提出了一个结构化框架，分类个性化带来的伦理风险（如隐私、偏见、自主性丧失）；2）通过实证研究揭示了风险在不同交互场景下的涌现机制；3）设计了负责任个性化的设计原则和评估指标。主要贡献在于填补了HRI中负责任个性化研究的空白，为开发安全、可信的个性化机器人系统提供了理论基础和实践指南。

AI医疗.title: X-FEMR: A Token-level Explainable Approach for Electronic Health Records Foundation Models using Transformer-based Models
AI医疗.title_zh: X-FEMR：基于Transformer的电子健康记录基础模型的令牌级可解释方法
AI医疗.summary: Foundation Models for Electronic Health Records (FEMRs) are pretrained on large-scale structured patient data, enabling them to convert longitudinal patient trajectories into generalizable representations for diverse clinical prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, FEMRs remain black-box models, hindering clinical adoption. We propose X-FEMR, a token-level explainable approach that attributes predictions to individual medical codes (e.g., diagnoses, medications) in the input sequence. By leveraging attention mechanisms and gradient-based attribution, X-FEMR provides faithful explanations without sacrificing performance. Experiments on three clinical prediction tasks show that X-FEMR achieves comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art FEMRs while offering interpretable insights. Our method also reveals clinically meaningful patterns, such as the importance of specific medications for readmission prediction.
AI医疗.summary_zh: 电子健康记录基础模型（FEMRs）在大规模结构化患者数据上预训练，能够将纵向患者轨迹转换为通用表示，用于多种临床预测任务。尽管效果显著，但FEMRs仍为黑箱模型，阻碍了临床采用。我们提出X-FEMR，一种令牌级可解释方法，将预测归因于输入序列中的单个医疗代码（如诊断、药物）。通过利用注意力机制和基于梯度的归因，X-FEMR在不牺牲性能的情况下提供忠实解释。在三个临床预测任务上的实验表明，X-FEMR在达到与最先进FEMRs相当准确率的同时，提供了可解释的洞察。该方法还揭示了具有临床意义的模式，例如特定药物对再入院预测的重要性。

自然语言处理.title: Spider 2.0-AIFunc: Extending Real-World Text-to-SQL to AI-Native SQL Workflows
自然语言处理.title_zh: Spider 2.0-AIFunc：将现实世界文本到SQL扩展到AI原生SQL工作流
自然语言处理.summary: Major cloud data platforms now expose large language model capabilities as native SQL functions, enabling analysts to perform classification, filtering, sentiment analysis, extraction, similarity search, and aggregation within ordinary SQL queries. Yet existing text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate only conventional SQL queries without AI functions. We introduce Spider 2.0-AIFunc, a benchmark extending Spider 2.0 to include AI-powered SQL functions. It comprises 678 complex queries across 23 enterprise databases, covering 12 AI function types. We evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs and find that even GPT-4 achieves only 38.2% execution accuracy. The benchmark reveals challenges in understanding AI function semantics, composing multiple AI functions, and integrating with complex SQL operations. Our work paves the way for AI-native database interactions.
自然语言处理.summary_zh: 主流云数据平台现已将大语言模型能力暴露为原生SQL函数，使分析师能够在普通SQL查询中执行分类、过滤、情感分析、提取、相似性搜索和聚合等操作。然而，现有的文本到SQL基准仅评估不含AI函数的传统SQL查询。我们提出Spider 2.0-AIFunc，一个将Spider 2.0扩展到包含AI驱动SQL函数的基准。它包含跨23个企业数据库的678个复杂查询，覆盖12种AI函数类型。我们评估了最先进的LLM，发现即使GPT-4也仅达到38.2%的执行准确率。该基准揭示了理解AI函数语义、组合多个AI函数以及与复杂SQL操作集成方面的挑战。我们的工作为AI原生数据库交互铺平了道路。

category_summaries.大语言模型与软件工程: 本日研究聚焦于利用大语言模型提升软件工程效率，包括代码生成、缺陷检测和自动化测试。趋势显示LLM在代码理解与生成方面取得显著进展，但面临幻觉和安全性挑战。亮点包括多步骤推理增强代码修复、以及结合静态分析的LLM辅助测试。
category_summaries.计算机视觉与生成模型: 研究集中于视觉生成模型的质量与可控性，如扩散模型的加速采样、高分辨率图像合成。趋势包括文本到3D生成和视频生成。亮点是提出新的注意力机制减少计算量，以及利用条件控制生成特定风格内容。
category_summaries.大语言模型与认知架构: 该方向探索LLM与认知架构的融合，旨在提升推理和规划能力。趋势强调思维链和工具使用。亮点包括将LLM嵌入自主决策系统，以及通过认知图增强长期记忆。
category_summaries.临床决策支持系统: 研究致力于将AI应用于临床决策，如诊断辅助和治疗推荐。趋势是利用多模态数据（影像、文本）和可解释性。亮点是提出基于知识图谱的临床路径优化，以及联邦学习保障数据隐私。
category_summaries.量子机器学习: 本日研究关注量子算法在机器学习中的应用，如量子核方法和变分量子电路。趋势是混合量子-经典模型。亮点是证明量子优势在特定分类任务上的实现，以及噪声鲁棒性改进。
category_summaries.生成模型: 研究涵盖GAN、VAE、扩散模型等，趋势是提升生成质量和多样性。亮点包括扩散模型的条件控制、以及新型采样方法减少步数。还涉及生成模型的评估指标改进。
category_summaries.多模态学习: 聚焦于视觉、语言、音频等多模态融合。趋势是跨模态对齐和联合表示学习。亮点包括提出统一的多模态预训练框架，以及在视频理解任务上的性能提升。
category_summaries.大语言模型/LLM: 核心研究包括模型压缩、推理加速、对齐技术。趋势是参数高效微调和长上下文处理。亮点是稀疏注意力机制降低计算复杂度，以及强化学习从人类反馈（RLHF）的改进。
category_summaries.优化算法: 研究涉及梯度下降变体、进化算法和贝叶斯优化。趋势是自适应学习率和随机优化。亮点是提出新的收敛性分析方法，以及针对非凸优化的加速策略。
category_summaries.物理信息神经网络: PINN用于求解偏微分方程。趋势是处理高维和复杂边界条件。亮点是自适应采样策略提高精度，以及将物理约束嵌入网络架构。
category_summaries.LLM & Code Generation: 与‘大语言模型与软件工程’重叠，本日研究强调代码生成的安全性和正确性。亮点是形式验证辅助代码生成，以及基于测试的迭代修复。
category_summaries.Reinforcement Learning / Game AI: 研究包括多智能体强化学习、探索策略和游戏AI。趋势是样本效率和泛化。亮点是提出内在奖励机制促进探索，以及在复杂策略游戏中的表现。
category_summaries.Audio Processing: 聚焦语音识别、合成和音频生成。趋势是端到端模型和自监督学习。亮点是提出新的语音分离架构，以及基于扩散模型的音频生成。
category_summaries.Vision-Language Models / Embodied AI: 研究视觉语言模型在具身智能中的应用，如导航和操作。趋势是结合语言指令和视觉感知。亮点是提出跨模态推理框架，以及模拟环境中的零样本泛化。
category_summaries.Prediction Markets / Game Theory: 研究预测市场机制和博弈论在AI中的应用。趋势是聚合预测和激励机制设计。亮点是提出基于区块链的预测市场，以及博弈论分析AI决策。
category_summaries.强化学习/RL: 与RL方向类似，强调算法创新，如离线RL和模型基RL。趋势是安全约束和奖励塑形。亮点是提出保守Q学习改进离线策略，以及结合因果推断。
category_summaries.NLP: 研究包括文本分类、命名实体识别和情感分析。趋势是预训练语言模型和少样本学习。亮点是提出新的提示学习方法，以及多语言模型改进。
category_summaries.计算机视觉/CV: 涵盖图像分类、目标检测、分割等。趋势是自监督学习和Transformer架构。亮点是提出高效的ViT变体，以及针对小样本检测的新方法。
category_summaries.人机交互/HCI: 研究人机交互中的AI辅助，如界面设计和用户建模。趋势是自然交互和可解释性。亮点是提出基于LLM的对话式UI，以及眼动追踪增强交互。
category_summaries.软件工程: 与‘大语言模型与软件工程’重叠，但更广泛。研究包括软件维护、配置和演化。趋势是自动化工具和DevOps。亮点是提出基于图神经网络的缺陷预测。
category_summaries.图神经网络: 研究图数据的表示学习，如节点分类和链接预测。趋势是动态图和大规模图。亮点是提出异构图注意力机制，以及结合时序信息的GNN。
category_summaries.大语言模型: 与‘大语言模型/LLM’重叠，本日强调LLM的伦理和安全。趋势是对齐和偏见缓解。亮点是提出基于强化学习的价值观对齐方法。
category_summaries.软件工程/SW: 与软件工程类似，本日强调AI在软件测试中的使用。亮点是自动化测试用例生成和故障定位。
category_summaries.自然语言处理/NLP: 与NLP类似，本日强调低资源语言处理。亮点是跨语言迁移学习和数据增强。
category_summaries.智能体/Agent: 研究自主智能体，如基于LLM的Agent。趋势是工具使用和长期规划。亮点是提出记忆增强的Agent架构。
category_summaries.软件工程/AI安全: 研究AI系统在软件工程中的安全性，如对抗样本和模型鲁棒性。亮点是提出针对代码生成模型的攻击与防御。
category_summaries.生成模型/加速推理: 专注于生成模型的推理加速，如蒸馏和量化。趋势是实时应用。亮点是提出扩散模型的一步生成方法。
category_summaries.AI在医疗中的应用: 与临床决策支持系统类似，但更广泛。研究包括医学影像分析、疾病预测。趋势是多模态融合。亮点是提出基于Transformer的病理诊断模型。
category_summaries.时间序列基础模型: 研究时间序列预测的基础模型，如预训练Transformer。趋势是通用时间序列表示。亮点是提出跨领域迁移学习。
category_summaries.可解释AI/XAI: 研究模型可解释性方法，如特征归因和概念解释。趋势是后验解释和因果解释。亮点是提出基于反事实的解释。
category_summaries.人机交互/机器人: 研究人机交互在机器人中的应用，如协作和远程操作。趋势是共享控制和意图理解。亮点是提出基于视觉的抓取规划。
category_summaries.AI医疗: 与‘AI在医疗中的应用’重叠，本日强调临床工作流集成。亮点是提出AI辅助诊断系统部署框架。
category_summaries.自然语言处理: 与NLP类似，本日强调对话系统。亮点是提出基于检索增强的对话生成。

highlights: 研究亮点1：《利用代码代理实现自动软件验证》提出将LLM作为策略生成器与自动化工具协作的框架，显著提升了形式化验证的自动化程度和效率，具有重要的软件工程实践价值。
研究亮点2：《ELSA3D：用于统一3D理解与生成的弹性语义锚定》通过弹性锚点实现文本与3D的显式交互，在多个任务上达到最先进性能，推动了3D基础模型的发展。
研究亮点3：《预测量子多体系统时间演化的可证明学习分离》从理论上证明了量子机器学习相对于经典模型的学习优势，为量子AI提供了坚实的基础。
研究亮点1：TILDE论文提出基于倾斜分布擦除的概念遗忘方法，通过分析潜空间几何结构实现高效概念移除，对生成模型的隐私保护和安全部署具有重要实用价值。
研究亮点2：UBEP论文针对生产级超级节点重新架构专家并行通信库，通过拓扑感知的层次化通信和动态负载均衡实现高达2倍加速，直接提升了大规模MoE模型训练效率。
研究亮点3：TOFFEE论文提出大规模合成数据智能体轨迹的学习系统，通过两阶段方法生成多样化轨迹，显著提升智能体泛化能力，对数据驱动决策的应用具有广泛前景。
VAORA框架：通过视觉动作结果推理对齐，显著提升视觉语言模型在物理推理任务中的泛化能力，减少幻觉，成功率提升超30%。
RuBench基准：首个以俄语原生任务规范评估编码代理的仓库级基准，揭示当前模型在多语言编码中的严重不足（成功率仅22%），推动多语言AI研究。
研究亮点1：DepthWeave-KV — 提出令牌自适应跨层残差分解的KV缓存压缩方法，在长上下文推理中实现高压缩比且不损失检索质量，对降低大模型部署成本有重要实用价值。
研究亮点2：Doomed from the Start — 通过探针级联从LLM智能体内部表征早期预测失败并提前终止，显著减少无效推理计算，提升多步任务效率，对智能体系统优化具有创新性和实用性。
daily_summary: 今日AI研究动态涵盖62篇论文，涉及33个类别，展现出多领域交叉与深度学习的持续演进。大语言模型（LLM）相关研究占据主导，尤其在软件工程（代码生成、缺陷检测）和认知架构（推理规划）方面，强调LLM的实用化与安全性。生成模型（扩散模型、GAN）在计算机视觉和音频处理中继续突破，加速推理技术成为热点。强化学习与多智能体系统在游戏AI和机器人控制中取得进展，样本效率提升。此外，AI在医疗中的应用（临床决策、影像分析）注重多模态融合和隐私保护，可解释AI研究推动模型透明化。整体趋势显示，AI研究正从单一模型向系统化、跨模态、安全可靠的方向发展，强调实际部署和伦理考量。
